nina-cs: Flywheel hitting sporadic 429s during onboarding boot. low QPS but 30% of initial embedding calls fail.
ofar (cs-eng): can you paste the init pattern? sounds like preflight/concurrency.
flywheel-inc: each process fires 10 parallel short requests at startup (~15 processes per host). token exchange ok. we use plain fetch per call.
omar (cs-eng): likely connection-per-request storm. quick mitigation: 1) reuse connections (agent/session) 2) stagger startup with small random backoff 3) ops: temporary per-tenant conn bump while they patch.
ops-bot: tenant flywheel-temp concurrent_sockets set to 160 until 2026-03-11T00:00Z; alert on sustained >100 conns/min.
flywheel-inc: switched to keep-alive agent, added 0-2s jitter; initial rollout cleared 429s. thanks.
nina-cs: follow-ups: add keepAlive example to quickstart and a checklist item for first-24h boot patterns. will close when stable.
